title: SH-01 CGX Identity Coupon — Benign Physical Proof Plan
objective: Prove that a benign physical coupon can carry a stable CGX object identity, bind that identity to a filespace snapshot and dataspace measurement record, and complete a readback/DBR cycle without granting actuation or physical-readiness authority.
evidence_boundary: This plan is not a physical test result.
Passing identity/readback does not qualify unrelated printed electronics, pressure, high-voltage, chemical, orbital or mission functions.
A passive identity endpoint does not imply smartphone-class onboard compute.
No durable .cgx carrier promotion is created by this plan.
actor_mode: DIY/education-safe planning baseline; professional review if materials/processes depart from benign low-energy route
horizon: H-TERR-SITE / exact site and resource state to be resolved at execution

cgx_identity.compute_profile: CP0-PASSIVE preferred; CP1-TINY optional only if a separately sourced benign seed device is intentionally included
cgx_identity.semantic_owner: Römer/Cognigrex lineage; identity alone creates no execution authority

dataspace: continuity/resistance or other selected benign sensor measurement

examples: QR/DataMatrix or equivalent stable optical marker

identity_route_options.route: printed antenna/contact geometry plus qualified passive/seed identification element
identity_route_options.seed_dependency: explicit seed device may remain imported
identity_route_options.boundary: seed device provenance and reader compatibility must be recorded; printed geometry alone is not cryptographic assurance

acceptance_gates.pass: read physical marker and resolve exactly one planned object record
test/measurement event references same object ID and immutable source snapshot
coupon material/process lot or source record is attributable
receipt is re-read and exact identity/hash fields match
record explicitly remains passive/benign and advertises no untested actuation or manufacturing capability

stop_conditions: unknown material provenance where it affects safe handling or test interpretation
attempt to treat identity success as physical qualification beyond the coupon
next_physical_output: One benign SH-01 coupon plus identity/readback/measurement/DBR receipt after BouwerBase or equivalent approved execution surface is available.

rationale: lowest-consequence route proving physical-object identity without energized function
no seed electronics, RF function or active device required for the first proof
separates filespace/dataspace/DBR correctness from later functional-material qualification
SH01-ID-B remains a later escalation only after Route A identity/readback acceptance passes
selection.substrate_selection_rule: Use a benign, nonconductive, mechanically stable substrate already on hand or from ordinary qualified stock. Bind the exact material identity, supplier/source and lot or traceable source record at execution; do not infer chemistry, durability or environmental qualification from the generic selection.
selection.marker_selection_rule: Use QR, DataMatrix or equivalent optical machine-readable marking that carries only the object identifier and/or a non-secret immutable manifest reference. Exact symbology, scale and marking process are selected only after a bounded print/readability check on the actual execution surface.

optional: ambient conditions when relevant to marker readability or substrate state

selection.execution_gate: BouwerBase or another approved execution surface must be online and pass current host/source/runtime readback before the physical coupon is created or its DBR receipt is promoted beyond Frontier.
